integrity_statement: The complete proof is contained in RESULT.md. Numerical tests are supporting examples and do not establish all-parameter validity or publication priority.
scientific_limitations: One predetermined binary sign from a zero-to-zero standard Brownian bridge; independent almost-surely finite symmetric additive sensor noise and a midpoint minimum of standardized noise scale. A Gaussian-noise assumption is needed only for the closed risk formula. No full-valued, multibit, adaptive, or asymmetric-channel optimality is claimed.
title: Distribution-free midpoint optimality for one-bit Brownian-bridge occupation sensing
